verdict.rationale: PlanetScale provides the building blocks for this story. The pscale CLI can create, delete and list Vitess, Neki and Postgres branches. A programmatic API and service tokens support non-interactive automation. Branches are positioned as isolated dev/test environments that mirror code branching, and a community user describes getting a database branch per Git branch. However, nothing shows a native CI or deploy-platform integration that creates and tears down branches per pull request automatically, so teams must script that lifecycle themselves. Missing for 10: a documented per-PR CI or deploy-platform integration (e.g., a GitHub Action or Vercel-style preview hook), documented automatic teardown on PR close, and hands-on corroboration of CI-driven branch automation.
